dish_name_kh: អន្សមជ្រូក

ingredients.raw_kh: អង្ករដំណើប
សាច់ជ្រូកបីជាន់
ស្លឹកខ្ទឹម
ស្លឹកឫស្សី

steps.text_kh: អង្ករដំណើបត្រាំទឹកបីឬបួនម៉ោង សណ្តែកបាយលាង រួចយកទៅត្រាំទឹកឱ្យរីកសំបក លាងសម្អាតចេញឱ្យស្អាត
steps.text_en: Soak glutinous rice for 3–4 hours; wash soybeans and soak until skins loosen; rinse clean.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer dessert dish Num Ansom Chrouk (Pork Rice Cake), step 1: Soak glutinous rice for 3–4 hours; wash soybeans and soak until skins loosen; rinse clean.

steps.text_kh: សាច់ជ្រូកហាន់វែងៗ រួចយកទៅប្រឡាក់អំបិល-ម្រេច ហាន់ស្លឹកខ្ទឹមដាក់លាយជាមួយ សណ្តែកបាយទៅដាំបាយសិន
steps.text_en: Slice pork into long strips; marinate with salt and pepper; slice lemongrass and mix in; cook soybeans first.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer dessert dish Num Ansom Chrouk (Pork Rice Cake), step 2: Slice pork into long strips; marinate with salt and pepper; slice lemongrass and mix in; cook soybeans first.

steps.text_kh: ជូនកាលយកក្បាលខ្ទិះលាយជាមួយអង្ករ ទើបយកស្លឹកចេកមកជូតពូតឱ្យស្អាត រួចយកអង្ករមកវាសដាក់លើស្លឹកចេក យកសណ្តែកដាក់លើអង្ករ រួចយកសាច់ជ្រូកដាក់កណ្តាលខ្ចប់ជាអន្សម ចងឱ្យជាប់មួយៗ
steps.text_en: Mix coconut head with rice; wipe banana leaves clean; spread rice on leaf, add soybeans, place pork in the center, and wrap each ansom tightly.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer dessert dish Num Ansom Chrouk (Pork Rice Cake), step 3: Mix coconut head with rice; wipe banana leaves clean; spread rice on leaf, add soybeans, place pork in the center, and wrap each ansom tightly.

steps.text_kh: យកស្លឹកឫស្សីមកទ្រាប់បាតឆ្នាំង យកអន្សមដាក់ដំរៀបឱ្យពេញល្មម យកស្លឹកឫស្សីគ្របពីលើឱ្យពេញ ទើបចាក់ទឹកឱ្យល្មម រួចលើកចង្ក្រាន
steps.text_en: Line the pot with pandan leaves; arrange the ansom; cover with more pandan; add enough water and bring to a boil.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer dessert dish Num Ansom Chrouk (Pork Rice Cake), step 4: Line the pot with pandan leaves; arrange the ansom; cover with more pandan; add enough water and bring to a boil.

steps.text_kh: កាលណាខះទឹកត្រូវចាក់ទឹកថែមទៀត ចំនួន៨ឬ៩ម៉ោង លុះតែឆ្អិន សឹមស្រង់ដាក់ក្រឡបោកតម្រៀបស្រេច
steps.text_en: Top up water as needed; steam 8–9 hours until cooked; drain and press in a mold to set.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer dessert dish Num Ansom Chrouk (Pork Rice Cake), step 5: Top up water as needed; steam 8–9 hours until cooked; drain and press in a mold to set.
